parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-15 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1132.2 | 7.42 | 7.42
2 | 3621.5 | 17.67 | 25.09
3 | 4447.9 | 1.70 | 26.79
4 | 4307.5 | 0.53 | 27.32
5 | 7664.9 | 4.92 | 32.24
6 | 12762.9 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-15
Curve type: KH-type (resistive layer overlying a thin conductive zone, within an overall ascending resistivity sequence)
Aquifer depth: 26.8 – 27.3 m (thin, relatively conductive zone — Layer 4 — sandwiched between higher-resistivity Layers 3 and 5, interpreted as a fractured/weathered water-bearing horizon)

Recommendation: Plan to screen the borehole across ~26.8–27.3 m to intersect this probable fracture zone; because the zone is thin (~0.5 m), continue drilling a few meters beyond to confirm whether secondary fracturing persists at depth before setting final casing, and log carefully through this interval to verify water strikes.
